title: HyperCache: Dynamic Cache Hierarchy Adaptation for ML Workloads
problem: Static cache hierarchies are suboptimal for ML workloads with diverse memory access patterns. Multi-level cache configurations cannot adapt to varying workload characteristics, leading to suboptimal performance.
motivation: ML workloads exhibit diverse memory access behaviors, and fixed cache configurations waste resources or miss optimization opportunities, motivating dynamic adaptation mechanisms.
method: HyperCache employs online profiling to characterize workload behavior at runtime and uses machine learning to predict optimal cache hierarchy configurations. The system dynamically reconfigures multi-level caches based on these predictions. Runtime performance metrics guide continuous adaptation to match evolving workload characteristics.
key_novelty: Machine learning-driven dynamic reconfiguration of multi-level cache hierarchies at runtime based on online workload profiling.
contributions: Dynamic cache hierarchy reconfiguration mechanism for ML workloads
Online profiling and ML-based prediction system for cache parameter optimization
3.2x speedup over static cache configurations on diverse ML workloads
primary_theme: Dynamic cache adaptation for ML workloads
